_meta.description: Seven weapons, five usable items and five map-built utilities, with the chapters and characters that can reach them.

availability.prequel: Act 0 is the five-chapter Fracture Year, played as Ilsa Renn.
availability.main: The present day is Acts I to VI, played as Lancer Ivanov.
availability.second_half_main: Acts III to VI bring in the Arc-Lance and the heavy Concord threat together.

weapons.name: P-20 "Courier"
weapons.notes: The standard sidearm for 20XX dispatch runners. It is light and accurate, but useless against chitin.

weapons.name: V-9 "Vigil"
weapons.notes: Named for the Concord's Vigilance Protocols. It shares 9mm ammunition with the P-20, so the two guns never fight over the last belt. This is a close-quarters gun, and it is loud.

weapons.name: M98 "Longhorn"
weapons.notes: A semi-automatic carbine developed by the pre-war defence contractor attached to the Longhorn Biological Facility. It is built for long sightlines: mortar crews on a roof, or the rear core of a Jammer looking the other way.

weapons.name: M-44 "Seam-Splitter"
weapons.notes: A magnetic demolition brick from 20XX. It opens collapsed concrete and welded airlocks, and it can drop a weakened floor out from under a charging Concord Ram. The prequel carries it; the modern Concord has moved past demolition charges.

weapons.name: K-12 "Key"
weapons.notes: A sawed-off pump-action breach shotgun loaded with hardened steel flechettes. It shreds chitin armour and Concord Divers at point-blank range, under eight metres. Outside eight metres, it is a very loud stick.

weapons.name: AT-7 "Goliath"
weapons.notes: A heavy 20XX rocket launcher. In the ordinary arsenal, it is the only weapon that cracks a 200 HP Warp Synth or a reinforced barricade. It is also the loudest thing Lancer can carry, and the Concord logs the noise.

weapons.name: L-01 "Arc-Lance"
weapons.notes: A prototype electromagnetic tungsten-slug accelerator, salvaged from the Concord Monolith and assembled by Henrik Solberg. It pierces a Jammer's static sphere and damages a Warp Synth. The second half of the campaign sounds different because this weapon is in it.

items.name: Field Ration / Trauma Kit
items.effect: Restores 25 HP, capped at the 100 HP base
items.notes: The Concord Med-Dispenser drops these on the wall. A Trauma Kit is the same thing by hand.

items.name: Adrenaline Stim-Pen
items.effect: Clears movement slow effects and triggers 25 points of decaying overheal for 10 seconds
items.notes: The clean answer to a Concord Stifler's coolant drag. The 25 points of overheal decay, like all overheal.

items.name: EMP / Signal Scrambler Flare
items.effect: Blinds sensor pylons, scrambles Warp Synth lock-on charges for 3 seconds, and delays Quarantine Bulkhead timers
items.notes: The throw has no sightline. Three seconds is enough to cross a sensor arc and not enough to fight in it.

items.name: Thermal-Foil Cloak
items.effect: Masks body heat from automated scanners while crouched or moving below 8 m/s
items.notes: It breaks the moment the wearer sprints, slides or shoots. Eight metres a second is the line. The cloak does not care why it was crossed.

items.name: Pneumatic Grapple Spool
items.notes: A heavy 20XX military rescue line from before the Filament tether existed. It gets Ilsa up the Spire and down again. It also makes the prequel climbs feel different from the present day.

utilities.name: Pneumatic Parcel Chutes
utilities.effect: Dead-drop tubes for smuggled drives and relays
utilities.notes: Built into alleys and stations. A parcel in a chute is a parcel in another block, and the chute decides how fast.

utilities.name: Concord Med-Dispenser
utilities.effect: Dispenses a Field Ration worth 25 HP
utilities.notes: Unlocked in 20XX. In the present day, it has to be cracked open with a cipher key or by shooting it open. The shots set off a local patrol chime.

utilities.name: Pressure Valves
utilities.effect: Vent scalding steam onto patrols, or open a high-velocity thermal
utilities.notes: Heavy industrial wheel-valves on Wind Regulators and Ventworks pipes. A valve is a weapon nobody thinks to shoot back.

utilities.name: Coolant & Fuel Barrels
utilities.effect: Detonate when shot or kicked into a hazard
utilities.notes: Pressurised steel drums. A barrel under a Warp Synth is a Warp Synth problem. A barrel under a collapsing walkway is a route.

utilities.name: Hardline Terminals
utilities.effect: Override local area denial for 15 seconds when keyed
utilities.notes: Exposed junction boxes wired into Quarantine Bulkheads and Interdiction Nodes. Fifteen seconds of the Concord not enforcing its own rules.
